name: Colorado Western Slope 2023
information: * It is recommended you register as soon as possible to save a spot. * No outside food and drink. * Be sure to familiarize yourself with the WCA regulations. If this is your first official competition, [this video](https://m.youtube.com/watch?v=dPL3eV-A0ww) will provide you with most of the information you need. * If this is your first competition, please be present for the competitor tutorial at 8:15 AM.
